description: Deliberate robustness probes: degenerate budgets, missing tiers, VRAM over-commit, the disk-swap fallback, prefill-dominant input, prefetch abuse, and leak checks. Runs last because the failure cases can leave the shared base model half-migrated.

cases.description: 50MB HBM budget — smaller than one layer's top-k working set.

50MB HBM budget in weight_transfer mode — the layer's top-k active set (~66 MiB) cannot fit and must be pinned all at once, so this must fail with make_room()'s actionable pinned-set-vs-capacity error, not a generic OOM.
cases.error: RuntimeError: Cannot make room for 17.3 MB in HBM: 4 pinned expert(s) already need 69.2 MB against an HBM budget of 52.4 MB, leaving no non-pinned resident to evict. A pinned set (e.g. one layer's full top-k active set) must fit entirely in HBM at once — raise hbm_cache_budget_bytes, or use execution_mode='hybrid' so cold experts execute in place instead of being pinned.

cases.description: host_dram=0, cxl=0, ample HBM — the documented historical crash case.
host_dram=0, cxl=0, HBM too small — must raise cleanly, not hang or corrupt.
cases.error: ValueError: Tier budgets cannot hold the model's experts: 1660.9 MB of expert weights vs 104.9 MB total capacity (HBM 104.9 + DRAM 0.0 + CXL 0.0 MB). There is no disk tier to spill to, so the shortfall of 1556.1 MB would be dropped and produce wrong output. Raise one of the tier budgets.

cases.description: 8000MB HBM cap on a 6GB card with a ~1.2GB expert set — cap should simply mean 'everything in HBM', not an error.
HBM+DRAM+CXL = 600MB total for a ~1.2GB expert set — must be refused at construction rather than silently dropping weights.
cases.error: ValueError: Tier budgets cannot hold the model's experts: 1660.9 MB of expert weights vs 629.1 MB total capacity (HBM 209.7 + DRAM 209.7 + CXL 209.7 MB). There is no disk tier to spill to, so the shortfall of 1031.8 MB would be dropped and produce wrong output. Raise one of the tier budgets.

cases.description: ~800-token prompt, 5 new tokens — exercises multi-token prefill, not the decode fast path.
prefetch_confidence_threshold=0.0 at a 400MB budget — maximal speculative thrash.
5x construct+unpatch — VRAM must return near baseline (the full suite builds 40+ wrappers).
